AdvertisingTech: Technology for creating, targeting, delivering and measuring advertising.
Analytics: Cross-industry products for analysing data and supporting decisions. Products specialised for a listed customer application belong to that application sector.
Artificial Intelligence: General-purpose AI models, development tools and infrastructure. Products applying AI to a listed customer problem belong to that application sector.
BioTech: Biological products and processes, including therapeutics and industrial biotechnology. Products developed specifically for medical diagnosis belong to MedTech; food-specific products belong to FoodTech.
CleanTech: Technologies reducing emissions, pollution or resource consumption, including carbon capture and water purification. Prefer EnergyTech for energy offerings and Sustainability for circular resource use.
Communication: Technologies for transmitting information and enabling people or organisations to communicate.
Crypto: Specialist sector under Fintech in this taxonomy, including blockchain infrastructure. Products whose central purpose is digital assets or blockchain infrastructure. Merely using blockchain does not determine the sector; prefer a specific customer application where applicable.
Cyber Security: Technologies protecting digital systems, identities and data from unauthorised access or attacks.
Drones: Specialist sector within Mobility. Uncrewed aircraft, their components and products specifically supporting their operation, including agricultural, delivery and defence drones. Prefer this specialist sector over Mobility.
E-Commerce: Storefronts, marketplaces and tools enabling transactions in goods. Prefer a listed specialist application, such as food or property, when that is the core customer problem.
EduTech: Products and services for teaching, learning, assessment and education management, whether delivered through software, hardware or people.
EnergyTech: Specialist sector under CleanTech in this taxonomy. Products and services for energy generation, storage, distribution and efficient consumption. Prefer this sector over CleanTech when the core customer problem is energy.
Fintech: Products and services for payments, banking, lending, investing and financial management. Prefer InsurTech for insurance and Crypto for digital-asset or blockchain infrastructure offerings.
GamingTech: Video games and technologies for game development, gameplay and gaming communities.
HardwareTech: General-purpose physical equipment, components and industrial automation, including industrial robots. Prefer a listed application sector or the specialist IoT, Micro / Nano, Drones or Quantum Technology category when applicable.
HealthTech: Products and services for healthcare delivery, administration, access, prevention and general health management. Products performing medical diagnosis or treatment belong to MedTech; biological therapeutics belong to BioTech.
HumanResources: Products and services for managing and supporting the workforce after hiring, including planning, development, engagement and HR administration. Candidate sourcing, assessment and hiring belong to Recruiting.
InsurTech: Specialist sector within Fintech. Products and services specifically for insurance distribution, underwriting, policy administration and claims. Prefer this specialist sector over Fintech.
Internet Platform: Cross-industry online services connecting participants, organisations or services. Prefer E-Commerce for transactions in goods, Productivity for completing work, or another listed application sector; online delivery alone is insufficient.
IoT: Specialist technology sector under HardwareTech in this taxonomy, including supporting software. Connected sensing and control systems that collect, exchange and act on physical-world data. Prefer a listed application sector when the offering is specialised for it; connectivity alone does not determine the sector.
LegalTech: Products and services for legal research, contracts, legal workflows and regulatory compliance, whether delivered through software, hardware or people.
Mobility: Products and services for transporting people and goods, including vehicles and transport operations. Uncrewed aircraft and products specifically supporting them belong to Drones.
Other: Evidenced offerings that fit neither a listed customer-application sector nor an appropriate technology sector. Use for unrepresented application areas when no such category fits, not for missing information.
Productivity: Cross-industry tools for organising, collaborating and completing work. Prefer a listed specialist application such as Recruiting or LegalTech when applicable.
PropTech: Products and services for construction, property development, transactions, management and building operations, including construction project management.
Quantum Technology: Hardware, software and infrastructure using quantum effects for computing, sensing or communication. This specialist category takes precedence over the broader HardwareTech or Communication category where applicable; it also includes quantum software.
Recruiting: Specialist sector within HumanResources. Products and services for finding, assessing, matching and hiring candidates. Prefer this specialist sector over HumanResources.
Sustainability: Subset of CleanTech focused on circular resource use: reuse, repair, recycling and waste reduction. Prefer this specialist sector over CleanTech for these offerings; other environmental benefits alone do not qualify.
TravelTech: Products and services for travel discovery, booking, accommodation and trip management. Transport vehicles and operations belong to Mobility.
Extended Reality: Enabling technologies for virtual, augmented and mixed reality. Products specialised for a listed customer application belong to that application sector.
FoodTech: Technologies and products improving food ingredients, production, processing, preservation or consumption.
Consumer Products: Physical goods primarily for personal or household use. Prefer a listed specialist application, such as FoodTech or MedTech, when applicable.
MedTech: Products performing a medical diagnostic, therapeutic or rehabilitation function, including devices, medical software and biological diagnostics. Biological therapeutics belong to BioTech; care delivery and administration belong to HealthTech.
Micro / Nano: Specialist technology sector within HardwareTech. Enabling components, materials and fabrication technologies at micro- or nanoscale. Prefer a listed application sector for specialised end products; small physical size alone does not qualify.
